prompt:
Rewrite snippets/bundle-eligibility-2.liquid so it shows which cart items count toward a bundle offer and whether the bundle is unlocked. Inputs (all are top-level variables; nothing is under section.settings): - `items`: array or null. Each element is an object that always has these fields: - `title`: string, never null. - `quantity`: integer, never null. It can be 0 or negative. - `bundle_eligible`: boolean, never null. - `min_items`: integer >= 1, never null. This is the number of eligible units required. - `discount_label`: string or null. Rules: 1. If `items` is null or an empty array, output nothing (empty string). 2. An item counts only when `bundle_eligible` is true AND `quantity` > 0. Eligible units = the sum of `quantity` over the counted items. Sum the quantities; do not count the number of items. 3. List: for each counted item, in input order, output `
  • TITLE xQUANTITY
    • `. TITLE is HTML-escaped. Example: `
  • Shampoo x2
    • `. Wrap all the li elements in a single `
      ...
    `. If no item counts, omit the `
      ` entirely. Never output an empty `
        `. 4. Status paragraph `

        ...

        `: - If eligible units >= min_items, the text is `Bundle unlocked: LABEL`. LABEL is `discount_label` with leading and trailing whitespace stripped, HTML-escaped. If discount_label is null or is empty after stripping, LABEL is `Bundle discount`. - Otherwise let N = min_items - eligible units. The text is `Add N more eligible items to unlock the bundle`. Use `item` (singular) when N is 1, giving `Add 1 more eligible item to unlock the bundle`. 5. The whole output must be a single line with no whitespace between tags: `
        [UL]

        TEXT

        ` Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/bundle-eligibility-2.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
